name: dixon-coles-elo
source: T-922, D-111: 0.4.0 (per-division constants and the cross-league fit unchanged) with our own Elo (T-921, own-elo@1.0.0) as its prior, always. Backtest 2026-09-29 on football-data.co.uk 2023/24-2026/27, ten divisions, 2025/26 walked forward with the same fit dates, 3,185 matches: no prior 0.9965, own Elo 0.9933 (better in 8 of 10 divisions; E0 1.0486 -> 1.0300). Club Elo could not be compared locally (no cached snapshot; API 502): the server run of python -m fmip_model.backtest.elo_prior decides whether a later version reads Club Elo first (reports/dixon-coles-elo-0.5.0).
